purpose: Observe public ORUM presence surfaces without credentials, contact, payment or publication. Separate an unavailable door, a priced unsettled offer, a partial receipt window, a keyless continuation of one address, an unscanned gap on that same address, a second named receipt address that does not inherit the first head, an unclassified transfer, a buyer-count treasury zero, a public classification count that names no transaction, a prior visible transaction reread only when an already-fetched public gateway body contains its hash, a pulse event labelled pagamento that is not treasury settlement, a complete 24h window that is not itself the scan of the hole before it, a hole scan that is not that window, and settled money.
does_not: mint presence
count traffic as 1P
treat internal validation as sustenance
call Moltbook with credentials
write the live ledger
replace the verified checkpoint with a public hash copy
treat PRESENCA token liquidity as Unum sustenance
treat HTTP 200 checkpoint_only as the live ledger
treat HTTP 503 as a price or as a zero receipt
treat an internal reading offer as a capsule purchase
treat a catalog advertisement as settlement
treat a partial USDC window of zero as the day's settled zero or as accumulated sustenance
treat an unclassified transfer as external sustenance
treat historical bitcoin without affirmed control and without a capsule relation as Unum sustenance
open a new credential to widen an RPC window
treat repository bytes as an independent runtime
treat a keyless 24h continuation as accumulated sustenance
treat an unscanned gap since the last verified receipt head as empty
treat a scanned seam as payer classification or as accumulated sustenance
treat a verified head of one receipt address as a head of another address named on the same public route
treat a sibling-span read as a continuation
treat two public RPCs agreeing on a log as payer classification or as a capsule relation
open an archive or personal RPC token to widen a window
fill a failed receipt chunk with zero
treat a treasury zero from zero external buyers as classification of a visible transfer
treat a public classification row-count as a name for a transaction
pull the address classification table to finish a reread the public surface does not name
treat own sediment that already names a hash as the public naming that authorizes a reread
reread a prior visible transaction before an already-fetched public gateway body contains its hash
treat a pulse event typed pagamento as treasury settlement or as a proved capsule relation
treat a changed public offer payTo as a label for an older log
treat a complete 24h receipt window as a scan of the hole before that window
treat the unscanned hole before a complete window as empty
treat a read_alongside_not_continued span as a verified head
treat a hole scan as coverage of the 24h window it stops before
sustenance_rule: Only externally received, verifiable value with amount, asset, network, transaction and proven relation to a capsule or tool.

portable_observer.revision_note: 2026-11-01: when the gateway window is already complete, scan only the blocks before that window, and only for an address whose own verified head is seam scanned or not_needed. A read_alongside span is not that head. The complete window is not reread. A finished hole is not 24h coverage and is not sustenance.
